name: Matthis Lahargoue
role: Machine Learning · Computer Vision · Scientific Computing
summary: Engineering student on an ENSISA/UQAC double-degree pathway, currently a computational imaging research intern at ISL. experience.title: Research Intern - Computational Imaging / NLOS
experience.text: Research on learning-based non-line-of-sight reconstruction. Work connects transient-light simulation, data preparation, model training and quantitative evaluation. Tools: PyTorch, Mitsuba 3, Dr.Jit, CUDA, Linux and HPC. Public description only; institutional research details remain confidential.

experience.title: Computer Vision / Applied ML Project
experience.text: Developed an offline CNN prototype for industrial tank image classification in a two-person team. Curated approximately 1,000 proprietary images. Addressed class imbalance, visual similarity and variable acquisition conditions with data preparation, transfer learning and class-level evaluation.

projects.title: CNN Stock Prediction - Reproducibility Study
projects.text: Public reproduction study using chronological evaluation, train-only normalization and explicit naive baselines. The investigated CNNs did not improve on the reported always-BUY baseline. Findings are specific to the tested setup.

projects.title: Basel Tram Air - Hack am Rhein Warm-up
projects.text: Interactive exploration of historical PM2.5 measurements along Basel tram corridors. Hourly aggregation, 262 spatial cells and a public map with slider/timelapse. Historical observations, not live measurements.

projects.title: Large-Scale Sentiment Analysis - UQAC
projects.text: Graduate project with PySpark, MinHash LSH and approximate k-nearest neighbors on Calcul Québec HPC infrastructure, studying representations and scaling on Sentiment140.
